BiblicalUsage: Chophshuwth is prostration by sickness, the wasting that keeps a king apart, and it belongs to two leprous kings. Azariah is smitten with leprosy and dwells in a separate house until his death, and Uzziah is a leper to the day of his death and dwells in a separate house, cut off from the house of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the separate house is the end of pride, because the king who lifted himself up ends his days apart from his people.
